name: Heel-to-Toe Walk

instructions.description: Stand tall and choose a straight clear path.
Step forward placing the heel of one foot directly in front of the toes of the other foot.
Take slow deliberate steps while keeping the trunk upright and the gaze forward.
Turn carefully and continue as planned.

variations.variationDescription: Dynamic progression of tandem stance with controlled forward stepping.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Hold the narrow base statically before adding steps.

commentsNotes: Use a wall or hallway rail for support if needed.
Step slowly enough to place each foot accurately.
